author: richburdon
principle: A container's story should render the container itself, not just the lower-level component it wraps.
fix_shape: instantiate the container component in the story instead of its child component directly.

author: richburdon
principle: Generate test/story fixture data with the shared random/faker utility rather than hand-rolled data generation.
fix_shape: replace manual literal test data with calls to the shared faker utility.

author: richburdon
principle: Prefer a plain function that returns test data over a stateful builder class when there's no real lifecycle to manage.
fix_shape: replace the chainable builder class with a function generating an array of items, and keep production sync logic in its own non-testing module.

author: richburdon
principle: Put an item's icon, title and actions menu in the design system's header primitive (e.g. Card.Header) rather than composing them ad hoc.
fix_shape: wrap the icon/title/menu in the design system's header component.

author: richburdon
principle: Don't put a blank line between a variable declaration and the code that immediately uses it.
fix_shape: remove the blank line separating the declaration from its use.

author: richburdon
principle: Use the design system's toolbar primitives instead of raw HTML elements styled to look like them.
fix_shape: replace ad hoc span/className markup with the equivalent Toolbar primitive components.

author: richburdon
principle: Give an ECHO object type a label annotation that derives a human-readable display string from its fields.
fix_shape: add a label annotation computing the label from the primary field, falling back to a secondary one.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name an internal submodule after the top-level exported module it backs, rather than introducing a new internal-only module name.
fix_shape: move/rename the internal file so its name mirrors an existing top-level export instead of adding a new one.

author: richburdon
principle: When documentation cites an external technology or protocol by name, link to its reference/spec.
fix_shape: add a hyperlink to the cited technology on first mention.

author: richburdon
principle: For a spec document defining a string format, include a formal grammar, not just prose rules, for clarity.
fix_shape: add a grammar block alongside the prose description.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When keeping a deprecated API around for a transition period, mark it with an @deprecated doc tag rather than leaving it undocumented.
fix_shape: add an @deprecated tag and a note pointing to the replacement.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name a class member holding an Effect Runtime `runtime`, matching the codebase's naming convention, rather than a bespoke name.
fix_shape: rename the field/property to `runtime`.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the project's shared test-layer helper for building test peers/services rather than constructing the setup manually.
fix_shape: swap the manual peer/service construction for the shared test-database layer helper.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name the field holding a service Runtime `runtime`, without a redundant prefix repeating the service's name.
fix_shape: rename the field to drop the redundant prefix.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When testing that an agent can use a tool, let the agent invoke it — don't have the test harness perform the action on the agent's behalf.
fix_shape: drive the flow through the agent's own tool-calling instead of calling the underlying function directly in test setup.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use a module's exported helper function instead of manually pulling the service out of context and calling its method.
fix_shape: call the wrapper function directly rather than yield*-ing the service tag and invoking its method.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Test a component through its real end-to-end path using the shared test layer, rather than unit-testing an internal helper function in isolation.
fix_shape: replace the direct function-level test with an end-to-end test driven through the shared test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Construct a service via the shared factory function (e.g. Service.make) rather than defining it ad hoc with a raw Context.Tag.
fix_shape: replace the direct Context.Tag class definition with the shared Service.make factory.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Construct a service via the shared factory function (e.g. Service.make) rather than defining it ad hoc with a raw Context.Tag.
fix_shape: rename the tag class and wrap it with the shared Service.make factory.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose a Layer-returning variant of a resource-acquiring function, not just an Effect-returning one, so callers can compose it directly via Effect.provide.
fix_shape: add a Layer-returning method built from the existing effect-returning method and use it at call sites.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Document a function's parameters with @param tags, not just prose above the function.
fix_shape: add @param entries for each parameter in the doc comment.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't keep a redundant lower-fidelity test alongside an end-to-end test that already covers the same behavior; keep the more realistic one.
fix_shape: delete the duplicate test that the end-to-end test already covers.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When testing whether an agent correctly interprets an instruction, phrase the test prompt naturally rather than spelling out the exact parameters, so the test actually exercises comprehension.
fix_shape: loosen the test prompt wording so the agent must infer values rather than restating them verbatim.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Pass related construction context (like a parent reference) into the factory function itself instead of setting it via a separate post-construction step.
fix_shape: add a parameter to the factory function and set the field there rather than in a follow-up setter call.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the project's shared test layer for this kind of test rather than building a bespoke layer stack, matching how sibling tests are written.
fix_shape: swap the custom Layer.mergeAll stack for the existing shared test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the project's shared test layer for this kind of test rather than building a bespoke layer stack, matching how sibling tests are written.
fix_shape: swap the custom layer stack for the existing shared test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the project's shared test layer for this kind of test rather than building a bespoke layer stack, matching how sibling tests are written.
fix_shape: swap the custom layer stack for the existing shared test layer.

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't write a custom implementation of a service that an existing layer already provides; depend on that layer instead.
fix_shape: remove the custom Layer.effect implementation and depend on the existing layer.

author: richburdon
principle: Keep sync/integration business logic in operations, independent of UI, not inside container components; separate the generic API client from the type-mapping code.
fix_shape: move the sync logic out of the container component into an operation, split into a generic API client and a mapper to domain types.

author: richburdon
principle: Build container components from the design system's existing patterns (Panel, Column, Form, etc.) rather than custom DOM elements and ad hoc classNames.
fix_shape: replace custom divs/classNames with the equivalent design-system components.

author: richburdon
principle: Don't implement the same business logic twice in different layers (e.g. once in a UI component and once in an operation); keep one implementation and have the other call it.
fix_shape: remove the duplicate implementation and have the component invoke the operation instead of reimplementing the logic.

author: richburdon
principle: When integrating a new external data source, map it onto existing generic domain types (extending them if needed) rather than introducing a parallel type hierarchy specific to the new source.
fix_shape: extend the existing generic type and write a mapper from the external API's shape to it, following the established mapper pattern.
